      "requirement": "Landlords may not evict tenants in fully or partially covered units without just cause. Fully covered units include most multifamily units built before 1980, single-family tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses. Partially covered units include new construction after June 1980, single-family tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 1996, and most condominiums. Per D006, some government-owned or government-subsidized units are now covered. Further Measure BB changes: tenants cannot be evicted for refusing to sign a substantially similar lease when a fixed-term lease expires. A material-lease-violation eviction requires a mutually agreed term, substantial actual damage to the landlord, and unreasonable tenant behavior, plus a prior notice that specifies the term and describes the violation and harm. Termination notices must include the Rent Board's housing counseling phone number and website.",

D009's table is garbled but appears also to exempt units with Section 202/811 or HUD-insured project-based subsidies, 'Golden Duplex' units, and certain ADU properties with an owner-occupied unit; these exemptions are unconfirmed.",
